line.name: La Flor Dominicana Capitulo II (Chapter Two)
line.description: Follow-up to the limited 'Chapter One' (first blend by Antonio Gomez, son of Litto Gomez; Chapter One was capped at 100,000 cigars / 10,000 boxes). Unveiled at the 2014 IPCPR Trade Show. Confirmed as its own limited-edition line, NOT part of Double Ligero despite the Mac filename's 'Lfd-' prefix.
line.status: limited edition (exact production cap not disclosed in sources found)
